source.author: verg
source.text: Mox et frumentis labor additus, ut mala culmos esset robigo segnisque horreret in arvis carduus; intereunt segetes, subit aspera silva, lappaeque tribolique, interque nitentia culta infelix lolium et steriles dominantur avenae.
source.text_original: Mox et frumentis labor additus, ut mala culmos / esset robigo segnisque horreret in arvis / carduus; intereunt segetes, subit aspera silva, / lappaeque tribolique, interque nitentia culta / infelix lolium et steriles dominantur avenae.
source.text_english: Soon toil was added also to the grain crops, so that destructive rust might be on the stalks and the sluggish thistle bristle in the fields; the crops perish, a harsh thicket comes up, and burdock and burrs, and amid the shining tilled fields unhappy darnel and barren oats take dominion.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Non solum in Ecclesia morantur oves, nec mundae tantum aves volitant; sed frumentum in agro seritur, interque nitentia culta Lappaeque et tribuli, et steriles dominantur avenae.
reuse.text_original: Non solum in Ecclesia morantur oves, nec mundae tantum aves volitant; sed frumentum in agro seritur, interque nitentia culta Lappaeque et tribuli, et steriles dominantur avenae.
reuse.text_english: Not only do the sheep remain in the Church, and not only do clean birds fly about; but grain is sown in the field, and among the flourishing crops are Burrs and thistles, and barren oats hold sway.
